parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to query the details of the clusters that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account, such as cluster IDs.

parameters.name: InterfaceVersion
parameters.description:
Deletes data masking or encryption rules. Valid values:

v1: deletes data masking rules. v2: deletes data encryption rules.

parameters.name: RuleNameList
parameters.description:
The name of the masking rule. You can specify multiple masking rules at a time. Separate the masking rules with commas (,).

> You can call the [DescribeMaskingRules](~~212573~~) operation to query details of all the masking rules for a specified cluster, such as the names of the masking rules.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb delete-masking-rules --rule-name-list testrule --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000000 --interface-version v1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb DeleteMaskingRules --region cn-hangzhou --InterfaceVersion v1 --RuleNameList testrule --DBClusterId 'pc-00000000000000000'
